description: Log labor time for farm work or tasks. The entry is always recorded for the user behind the API key. Supports confirm and idempotency validation.

category.description: Work category (e.g. Feeding, Cleaning, Maintenance, Processing)

confirm.description: Set to true to commit, false for dry-run preview

date.description: Optional log date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today in farm time zone)

minutes.description: Labor time spent in minutes (integer from 1 to 1440)

name: log_time
